text.autoconfig.simplevisuals.title: Simple Visuals
text.autoconfig.simplevisuals.option.par:
Local cosmetic setting; changes do not affect
gameplay. Default: SUBTLE.
text.autoconfig.simplevisuals.option.vis: Player Locator

Player heads for Vanilla waypoints; server
visibility and bar priority remain. Default:
true.
Chat Heads

Displays the player's head next to their chat
messages. Default: true.
Status Effect Bars

Shows a duration bar under status effect
icons. Default: true.
Elytra Pitch Helper

Shows guide lines for perfect pitch while
gliding. Default: true.
Target Angle Up

Optimal upward pitch angle for Elytra flight.
Default: -40.0.
Target Angle Down

Optimal downward pitch angle for Elytra
flight. Default: 40.0.
Pitch Tolerance

Acceptable deviation from target angles for
optimal Elytra flight. Default: 10.0.
Guide Sensitivity

Responsiveness of the pitch guide lines.
Default: 4.0.
Renamed item model compatibility

Compatibility; automatically disabled with
Simple Models. Enables custom textures for
renamed items based on the files in the
config folder. §cRequires a game restart to
take effect! Default: false.
Enable Anvil Formatting codes

The server policy decides; Vanilla costs
remain. Allows using '&' as a formatting code
in anvils (e.g., &c for red, &k for magic).
Default: true.
Enhance own death messages

Appends coordinates [x, y, z] to chat death
messages if the player is in render distance.
Default: true.
Own death coordinates

Only your own death coordinates, entirely
local. Default: SEPARATE.
Map Tooltips

Shows coordinates and biome info when
hovering over maps in the inventory. Default:
true.
Enable

Local cosmetic setting; changes do not affect
gameplay. Default: true.
Scale

Local cosmetic setting; changes do not affect
gameplay. Default: 1.0.
Color normal

Local cosmetic setting; changes do not affect
gameplay. Default: 16777215.
Color special

Local cosmetic setting; changes do not affect
gameplay. Default: 16766720.
Show border

Local cosmetic setting; changes do not affect
gameplay. Default: true.
Enable

Local cosmetic setting; changes do not affect
gameplay. Default: false.
Display duration

Local cosmetic setting; changes do not affect
gameplay. Default: 60.
Cooldown seconds

Local cosmetic setting; changes do not affect
gameplay. Default: 60.
Y offset

Local cosmetic setting; changes do not affect
gameplay. Default: 50.
Enable Speed Lines

Displays speed lines when moving fast with
elytra. Default: true.
Speed Lines Color (Hex)

Color of the speed lines in hexadecimal
format (e.g., #FF0000 for red). Default:
16777215.
Speed Lines Transparency

Transparency of the speed lines (0 = fully
transparent, 255 = fully opaque). Default:
0.7.
Speed Lines Amount

Number of speed lines to display. Default:
1.0.
Speed Lines Tunnel Radius

Radius of the speed lines tunnel effect.
Default: 0.7.
Speed Lines Width
Width of each speed line. Default: 8.0.
Speed Lines Animation Speed

Speed of the speed lines animation. Default:
1.0.
Speed Lines Length
Length of the speed lines. Default: 4.0.
Speed Lines Speed Threshold

Minimum speed required to display speed
lines. Default: 0.6.
Enable Held Item Tooltips

Local cosmetic setting; changes do not affect
gameplay. Default: true.
Show Durability

Local cosmetic setting; changes do not affect
gameplay. Default: true.
Show Enchantments

Local cosmetic setting; changes do not affect
gameplay. Default: true.
Max Enchantments to Show

Local cosmetic setting; changes do not affect
gameplay. Default: 3.
Enable Pickup Notifier

Displays a notifier on screen when picking up
items or XP. Default: true.
Offset X

Horizontal offset of the pickup notifier on
the screen. Default: 10.
Offset Y

Vertical offset of the pickup notifier on the
screen. Default: 10.
Scale

Scale of the pickup notifier display.
Default: 1.0.
Display Duration

Duration (in seconds) the pickup notifier
remains visible. Default: 120.
Show XP

If enabled, the pickup notifier will also
display XP pickups. Default: true.
Screen Side

Side of the screen where the pickup notifier
appears (Left or Right). Default: RIGHT.
Content Layout

Layout of the pickup notifier content
(Horizontal or Vertical). Default:
COUNT_ICON_NAME.
Show item icon

Displays the item icon in the pickup
notifier. Default: true.
Show item name

Displays the item name in the pickup
notifier. Default: true.
Show item count

Displays the item count in the pickup
notifier. Default: true.
Use rarity color

Colors the item name based on its rarity.
Default: true.
Vanilla background style

Uses the vanilla Minecraft style for the
pickup notifier. Default: true.
Background Opacity

Opacity of the pickup notifier background
(0.0 - 1.0). Default: 1.0.

simplevisuals.guide.page.1.title: Simple Visuals
simplevisuals.guide.page.1: Bounded client HUD, tooltips, anvil formatting and Vanilla immersion particles. Open this guide again with /simplevisuals guide.
simplevisuals.guide.page.2.title: Speed lines
simplevisuals.guide.page.2: Bounded radial lines at high speed or acceleration; cosmetic only, first-person view.
simplevisuals.guide.page.3.title: Pickup notifications
simplevisuals.guide.page.3: Server pickup animations create up to eight short-lived item or XP rows, with four layouts, scale, side, opacity and rarity colors. No inventory mutation.
simplevisuals.guide.page.4.title: Elytra pitch helper
simplevisuals.guide.page.4: Two target lines while gliding; defaults -40 and 40 degrees, tolerance 10, sensitivity 4. Does not change flight.
simplevisuals.guide.page.5.title: Status effect duration bars
simplevisuals.guide.page.5: HUD and inventory bars compare the current duration with the greatest observed duration of that active effect. Infinite effects have no bar; reconnecting clears history.
simplevisuals.guide.page.6.title: Locator player heads
simplevisuals.guide.page.6: Uses only server-supplied Vanilla waypoints; replaces eligible icons with player heads and
simplevisuals.guide.page.7.title: Locator player heads
simplevisuals.guide.page.7: keeps Vanilla angles, visibility and elevation arrows. SimpleBuilding contextual bars keep their priority.
simplevisuals.guide.page.8.title: Chat player heads
simplevisuals.guide.page.8: Faces beside recognizable player messages use cached Vanilla skins. No skin download service or custom chat packets.
simplevisuals.guide.page.9.title: Local death coordinates
simplevisuals.guide.page.9: Disabled, appended, or separate local coordinate line for your own death message.
simplevisuals.guide.page.10.title: Local death coordinates
simplevisuals.guide.page.10: Appended is still local, never public; other players' positions are not revealed.
simplevisuals.guide.page.11.title: Map preview tooltips
simplevisuals.guide.page.11: A 128-pixel map preview, center coordinates and dimension id from map data already available to this client.
simplevisuals.guide.page.12.title: Held item information
simplevisuals.guide.page.12: Durability and up to eight enchantment lines accompany the Vanilla held-item name. Enchantment changes refresh the notification.
simplevisuals.guide.page.13.title: Damage indicators
simplevisuals.guide.page.13: Up to 32 short-lived numbers for observed health decreases of nearby visible living entities. Values above eight
simplevisuals.guide.page.14.title: Damage indicators
simplevisuals.guide.page.14: use the special color; this does not prove a critical or Smite hit. Solid blocks hide numbers.
simplevisuals.guide.page.15.title: Biome notifications
simplevisuals.guide.page.15: Optional biome name on transition, with display duration, offset and re-entry cooldown. Disabled by default.
simplevisuals.guide.page.16.title: Anvil formatting and uses
simplevisuals.guide.page.16: Valid & or section-sign color/style codes are accepted only under server formatting policy. Vanilla anvil costs and 50-character name limit remain.
simplevisuals.guide.page.17.title: Anvil formatting and uses
simplevisuals.guide.page.17: Shows prior work uses from repair cost when no result is present.
simplevisuals.guide.page.18.title: Renamed model compatibility
simplevisuals.guide.page.18: Opt-in CIT JSON under assets/<namespace>/cit and PNG files in config/simplevisuals/textures.
simplevisuals.guide.page.19.title: Renamed model compatibility
simplevisuals.guide.page.19: Exact custom-name match, item filter, tags, deterministic weight priority, bounded search pages and anvil
simplevisuals.guide.page.20.title: Renamed model compatibility
simplevisuals.guide.page.20: rename instructions. Generated Vanilla item definitions bridge legacy model paths. At most 128 rules;
simplevisuals.guide.page.21.title: Renamed model compatibility
simplevisuals.guide.page.21: PNGs at most 1 MiB and 256 pixels per axis. Simple Models, when installed, owns this feature and disables this compatibility handler.
simplevisuals.guide.page.22.title: Configuration commands
simplevisuals.guide.page.22: Server: /simplevisuals config visuals enableAnvilFormatting [true|false], administrator only. Cosmetic options use
simplevisuals.guide.page.23.title: Configuration commands
simplevisuals.guide.page.23: the local client screen; server settings never overwrite another player's HUD.
